_comment: Which fields a brand profile has (ADR-194; task-350). The installation's
own structure: one company declares two font sizes, another four.
The CORE is always present and is not declared here: legal_company_name,
legal_address, imprint_url, privacy_url (required on every profile),
unsubscribe_text (required on marketing profiles), and the optional link
tags utm_source, utm_medium and utm_extra. A core field may be listed here
only to change its label or group; its type and requiredness are fixed.
Types: colour, font_family, size, image, text, url, number. Names match
[a-z][a-z0-9_]* because brand.css and the templates refer to them.
The Look fields below are what storage/modules/email/brand.css reads, as
var(--name, fallback); its fallback is today's look, used while a profile
leaves the field empty (task-354). A field brand.css names but this file
does not declare always uses its fallback. Module templates read every
Careful: adding a field with "required": true makes every existing profile
incomplete, and sends using it are refused until someone fills it in.
